probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Sunday, 8 November 2026 Italy 1 - 0 Denmark 67' Brekke 6-4 3-2 Ferraro Set 2 Spain 88 - 81 Greece Final Norway 2 - 2 Austria Final Italy 76 - 70 France Final Portugal 20:45 Sweden Today Sign in The Absurdist Football Basketball Tennis Cycling Formula 1 Athletics Opinion Overview Buy Phanatik Football Basketball Tennis Cycling Formula 1 Athletics Opinion Sign in Overview Buy Phanatik About World sport, reported by people who were there. The Absurdist started as a newsletter Henrik Solvang sent to forty friends after a cup final nobody else wrote about properly. It grew into a desk of six writers who travel to the games, stand in the mixed zone and stay after the press conference. We cover football, basketball, tennis, cycling, Formula 1 and athletics, and we write about them the way you talk about them with friends: with the facts first and the opinions clearly labelled. There are no betting adverts and no auto playing videos. The news is free. Members pay for the long reads, and that pays for the trains, the flights and the time it takes to get a story right. First story published 2019 Writers on the desk 6 Countries reported from 41 Members paying for it 18,400
